ctx.x: Yeah, the tenor player, the tenor player. Joe Thomas, this Hooks, John Hooks. Oh, I forgot who all was in that band. But anyway, they were some rich family loved music and they backed this band. And they got some of the best musicians, they called them Morrison's Grenadiers, the family was named Morrison. So they got this band together around Columbus and they went to Cleveland, and they asked my mother could I go to Cleveland. She said, 'Yes, if you go and come back and go to school.'
